C1396.title: Silex Botnet Attack Damages IoT Devices with Default Credentials
C1396.summary: In 2019, Akamai disclosed that Silexbot scanned internet-accessible IoT devices still using default login credentials. After gaining access, it performed destructive actions that prevented devices from operating or connecting normally. The incident shows how default credentials expose connected devices to automated intrusion and destructive attacks at scale.
